retained_rows.assessment_basis: The unwanted access/service behaviour directly engages the OECD repair proposition. OpenAI reported authentication recovery by about 08:20 PDT and full ChatGPT metric recovery by 09:00, corroborated by falling outage reports. This affirmatively supports repair in the reported restoration stage, bounded to the disclosed affected scope. It does not establish prevention of recurrence, full internal controls or every individual user outcome.
retained_rows.identification_basis: The preserved service-restoration evidence directly identifies the OECD appropriate repair proposition independently of a taxonomy-derived candidate.

retained_rows.assessment_basis: An overloaded authentication-edge dependency reduced ChatGPT and related login availability, with ordinary availability errors unnecessarily triggering login. Loss of the operational GAI use context makes stakeholder communication planning relevant. Public status updates are affirmative communication evidence, but the record does not supply the maintained plan, context-specific contact provisions and full workaround/alternative-process coverage required by MG-2.4-001. The planning outcome remains unresolved without using voluntary adoption as a gate.
